AI Notes.value: Inger Bierma: Berlin-based 2D animator and illustrator (originally Netherlands), graduated Minerva Art Academy c.2020. Signature style: pastel, hazy/abstract aesthetic, subliminal feeling. Key projects: BLANKET (2020 graduation short, festival-selected); Leoni Leoni - Weirdest Ritual music video (2021, Fantoche 2022 selection, Prague Music Video Awards); Nike International Women's Day Campaign starring Li Na (2022); CAKE FX Interstitial Animations S5E1 (2022). Work scope: illustration and 2D animation (TvPaint). Freelance: LinkedIn confirmed as freelance illustrator/animator; Graphic Days 2023 bio also lists as independent. Autonomy 3: early-career solo maker, strong festival traction but limited seniority evidence; works independently but no evidence of directing large teams. Note: myportfolio.com (ingerbierma.myportfolio.com) is dead; Vimeo (vimeo.com/ingerbierma) is her active portfolio. IG screenshot captured logged-out; Vimeo covers her work comprehensively. Separate younger Inger Bierma (Academie Minerva student, Groningen) exists; this entry is the Berlin director/animator.
